==Description==
A-60i is the 1st prime variant (A-20i is a super variant) you can encounter, it can spawn only after A-60 despawns.

==Behavior==
A-60i cannot spawn on its own, instead it has a chance to spawn after A-60 despawns. If A-60i does spawn, increased static would be seen and heard. A-60i will rush to the current room silently making very little noise until it is very close to the main room. Once A-60i makes it, A-60i will despawn similar fashion to A-60 although faster. A-60i does the same damage as A-60 in every way. If a player exits before A-60i fully disappears, A-60i deals rapid damage to them.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* If you notice that static continue in your screen even after [[A-60]] have completely despawned, go back to hiding because means that '''A-60i''' is coming.
* If static continue even after '''A-60i''' attacked, hide again, because another '''A-60i''' is coming. 
* For some reason, '''tables''' work for '''A-60i''', just use sprint to get under it to avoid getting sniped by '''A-60i'''.
* '''A-60i''' will be almost guaranteed in the Red Rooms after A-60 or another '''A-60i'''
* '''A-60i''' can spawn after another '''A-60i'''
** If you keep having high static on your screen, hide as another '''A-60i''' has spawned
* '''A-60i''' cannot spawn if [[A-60]] gets shot
* Just like [[A-60]], '''A-60i''' can be dodge rolled to survive though you'll get sniped
